handoffs.name: monitor
handoffs.do: Read the run records and the code reviews not yet reviewed, and write findings.

handoffs.name: propose
handoffs.do: Write change proposals from the open findings, quantify each one's upsides and downsides, and order them. In a later round, revise them from the proposal reviews.

handoffs.name: review
handoffs.do: Review the proposals at the top of the order. Say in the step's reply whether further review can still materially change them: "loop": "again" or "done".

handoffs.name: user-review
handoffs.do: Review the reviewed proposals, and give feedback and numerical corrections.

handoffs.name: decide
handoffs.do: Approve some proposals as change requests, and postpone or reject the others, each with its reason.

handoffs.name: code
handoffs.do: Write the approved change requests on a branch, in order. Run each one's gates, and report each result in the step's reply.

handoffs.name: trial-runs
handoffs.do: Make trial runs of the candidate v+1, side by side with v when both can run, on the active use cases, with the run command. Grade each run.

handoffs.name: code-review
handoffs.do: Review the diff of each change the coder passed, and accept the code or request changes.

handoffs.name: release
handoffs.do: Release v+1 or keep v, with the code reviews in hand, and with the graded trial runs when there are any.

handoffs.name: runs-after-release
handoffs.do: Run the released version on the active use cases, with the run command. Grade each run.
